titleRomaji: Shiou no Kikan: Moto Yuusha no Ore, Jibun ga Soshiki Shita Chuuni Himitsu Kessha o Tomeru tame ni Futatabi Isekai ni Shoukan Sareteshimau
titleNative: 屍王の帰還　～元勇者の俺、自分が組織した厨二秘密結社を止めるために再び異世界に召喚されてしまう～
synonyms: The Return of the Corpse King
synopsis: "How can my past self get so excited doing all those embarrassing things!?" When he was in the third year of middle school, Hizaki Shiou was summoned to another world to save it. After defeating the Demon King, he was forcibly returned back to the present day. Yet another three years later, he is summoned to the other world once again, this time to stop the rampage of the secret society "Helheim." That organization was supposedly actually the one that he had founded during his chuunibyou phase, where he called himself the "Corpse King"—a dark past too embarrassing to remember! Someone seems to be impersonating the name of "Helheim" and tarnishing its reputation. To uncover the truth behind this mystery and clear the organization's name, the Corpse King reunites with his former subordinates, the "Hakkai," who once made Helheim the strongest it had ever been. While agonizing over his dark past, he begins to take action in the other world once again. Their first stop is the Steel City of Gagiul—rescue the city struggling through famine as well as the pale-looking count's daughter in distress. "Helheim, moving out. (Source: Comic-Walker, translated)

title: Shut up, Evil Dragon, I Don't Want to Raise A Child with You Anymore
titleEnglish: Shut up, Evil Dragon, I Don't Want to Raise A Child with You Anymore
titleRomaji: Bizui Elong Wo Bu Xiang Zai Gen Ni Dai Haizi Le
titleNative: 闭嘴恶龙我不想再跟你带孩子了
synopsis: The dragon slayer Leon was defeated and captured by the Silver Dragon Queen. With his life on the line, he tried to use forbidden magic to curse the dragon queen, but the curse had unexpected side effects, and the queen lost control as they had a one-night stand. He thought that the shame she would carry for the rest of her life would be enough to fulfill his life's purpose as a dragon slayer. But two years later, when Leon opened his eyes, he found a young dragon girl with a tail sleeping next to him…

title: Amamiya-san is the Cutest…and I’m a Close Second!
titleRomaji: Sekai de Ichiban “Kawaii” Amamiya-san, Nibanme wa Ore.
titleEnglish: Amamiya-san is the Cutest…and I’m a Close Second!
titleNative: 世界で一番『可愛い』雨宮さん、二番目は俺
synonyms: The World's Most 'Cutest' is Amamiya-san, and the Second is Me.
synopsis: Hikari is a popular model nicknamed the “Cutest Girl in the World,” but behind that gorgeous female façade is an ordinary high school boy named Harema Kouki! Since his model self is so adorable, Kouki never really finds other girls cute…until one day, when he realizes his plain and boring classmate, Amamiya-san, is actually cuter than he is! A high school rom-com between an overconfident diva and a diamond in the rough! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: JIN: Kakutoha Oden
titleRomaji: JIN: Kakutoha Oden
titleNative: JIN 格斗破王伝
synonyms: Jin: Legend of the Dipper Style Destruction King
synopsis: In the not-too-distant future... In a society where corruption has spread and dreams and hopes have disappeared, an illegal, no-rules underground fighting sport called "Yaoyorozu" has thrived. Brutal street fights are waged anywhere and everywhere, driven by money and human desire. Jin Matsuya, a delinquent who repeatedly steals from the city, gets caught up in the violence. However, his qualities as a fighter are overwhelming... A new generation of spectacular battle action begins, where an extraordinary monster destroys everything! (Source: Kodansha, translated)
